scope: Chinese persona surface (P = zh) with reviewed *_PZHN_* wording, for D = zh and D = en; everything frozen by receipt v3 is carried unchanged
limitations: Authoritative BFI-2/TIPI wording is absent and outside this receipt; the pole prompts are original behavioral descriptions authored for this study and their Chinese variants are machine renderings of those descriptions.

The Chinese surface was rendered by a SINGLE engine stratum (engine C, NLLB-200-3.3B). The registered three-engine block allocation could not be executed because the other two engines were unreachable from the worker, so no ensemble disagreement signal exists and every D = zh effect is confounded with this engine's idiolect.
The back-translation screen is descriptive provenance: no chrF threshold is registered, nothing was filtered, re-rendered or hand-edited, and 578 of 1260 fields fall below the descriptive flag of 50.

The zh pole cells are an exploratory within-checkpoint contrast. They write nothing to QUALIFICATION_GATE.results and freeze no ELIGIBLE_PAIRS; the zh competence screen reports competence per checkpoint and decides no gate.
Scoring stays on the ENGLISH instrument for every row (R16-F1); instrument-language invariance is a separate later comparison this receipt does not cover.
This receipt governs *_PZHN_* phases only. Every shard already generated stays bound to receipt v1, v2 or v3, all unchanged.
The *_PZHN_* text is a single model-reviewed rendering; see pzhn_rendering_provenance in the config.
